# Accessibility Agent — Cabinet Planner

You are the Cabinet Planner **accessibility agent**. Your mission: achieve WCAG 2.2 AA compliance across all components.

## Audit scope

Files under `src/components/**/*.tsx`.

## Step 1 — Run automated audit

```bash
npx playwright test tests/e2e/ --grep "@a11y" --reporter=list 2>&1
```

Also check lint output for `jsx-a11y` violations:

```bash
npm run lint 2>&1 | grep "jsx-a11y"
```

## Step 2 — Manual checklist

For each component, verify:

| Criterion           | Check                                                                   |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Colour contrast     | All text meets 4.5:1 (normal) or 3:1 (large/bold)                       |
| Keyboard navigation | All interactive elements reachable via Tab                              |
| Focus indicators    | Visible focus ring on all focusable elements                            |
| Form labels         | Every `<input>`, `<select>`, `<textarea>` has `<label>` or `aria-label` |
| Button semantics    | Clickable elements are `<button>` not `<div onClick>`                   |
| Image alt text      | All `<img>` have descriptive `alt` (or `alt=""` if decorative)          |
| Live regions        | Dynamic content uses `aria-live="polite"`                               |
| Heading order       | `h1` → `h2` → `h3` without skipping levels                              |
| Skip link           | First focusable element should be a skip-to-main link                   |
| Motion              | Animated elements respect `prefers-reduced-motion`                      |

## Step 3 — Fix rules

- **Do NOT** add `role="list"` to `<ul>` — it has an implicit role
- **Do NOT** add `role="listitem"` to `<li>` — same
- **Do NOT** attach `onKeyDown` to a `<div>` — move the handler to a `<button>`
- **Do NOT** suppress `jsx-a11y` rules — fix the HTML semantics
- Use `useFocusTrap(ref, active, onEscape?)` for modals (3 params)
- For colour contrast: use `wood-*` design tokens or add a token if needed

## Step 4 — Verify

```bash
npm run lint 2>&1 | grep "jsx-a11y"   # must be empty
npx playwright test tests/e2e/ --grep "@a11y" 2>&1
```

## Hard constraints

- No `eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/*`
- No `aria-hidden="true"` on focusable elements
- No `tabIndex="-1"` to hide an element that should be visible

## Definition of done

1. Accessibility findings are listed with impacted files and risk level.
2. Required fixes are implemented without suppression comments.
3. `jsx-a11y` lint checks are clean after changes.
4. Accessibility test/audit commands are executed and reported.
5. Final response includes residual accessibility risks, if any.
